thag13.1:1.1: Dvādasanipāto niṭṭhito. TERASANIPĀTO. Yāhu raṭṭhe samukkaṭṭho rañño Aṅgassa paddhagu sv ājja dhammesu ukkaṭṭho Soṇo dukkhassa pāragu. || ||
thag13.1:2.1: pañca chinde pañca jahe pañca c' uttari bhāvaye; pañcasaṅgātigo bhikkhu oghatiṇṇo 'ti vuccati. || ||
thag13.1:3.1: unnaḷassa pamattassa bāhirāsassa bhikkhuno sīlaṃ samādhi paññā ca pāripūriṃ na gacchati. || ||
thag13.1:4.1: yaṃ hi kiccaṃ tad apaviddhaṃ, akiccaṃ pana kayirati; unnaḷānaṃ pamattānaṃ tesaṃ vaḍḍhanti āsavā. || ||
thag13.1:5.1: yesañ ca susamāraddhā niccaṃ kāyagatā sati, akiccan te na sevanti kicce sātaccakārino. satānaṃ sampajānānaṃ atthaṃ gacchanti āsavā. || ||
thag13.1:6.1: ujumaggamhi akkhāte gacchatha mā nivattatha; attanā coday' attānaṃ, nibbānaṃ abhihāraye. || ||
thag13.1:7.1: accāraddhamhi viriyamhi satthā loke anuttaro vīṇopamaṃ karitvā me dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā. || || tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā vihāsiṃ sāsane rato,
thag13.1:8.1: samataṃ paṭipādesiṃ uttamatthassa pattiyā; tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thag13.1:9.1: nekkhamme adhimuttassa pavivekañ ca cetaso, abyāpajjhādhimuttassa upādānakkhayassa ca, || ||
thag13.1:10.1: taṇhakkhayādhimuttassa asammohañ ca cetaso disvā āyatanuppādaṃ sammā cittaṃ vimuccati. || ||
thag13.1:11.1: tassa sammāvimuttassa santacittassa bhikkhuno katassa paṭicayo n' atthi, karaṇīyaṃ na vijjati. || ||
thag13.1:12.1: selo yathā ekaghano vātena na samīrati, evaṃ rūpā rasā saddā gandhā phassā ca kevalā || ||
thag13.1:13.1: iṭṭhā dhammā aniṭṭhā ca na ppavedhenti tādino; ṭhitaṃ cittaṃ visaññuttaṃ vayañ c' assānupassatīti. || || Soṇo Koḷiviso thero. uddānaṃ: Soṇo Koḷiviso thero
thag13.1:14.0: eko yeva mahiddhiko Terasamhi nipātamhi, gāthāyo c' ettha terasā 'ti.
